history_summary: Add two bacterial species-reference GTDB correspondences to the Viili consortium
history_details: The selected Lactococcus lactis and Lacticaseibacillus paracasei species-ID routes report reference populations 893/fraction 0.92 and 682/fraction 1.0. These populations do not identify the genomes of source stocks V9 and V21 or an EPS genotype, and the rounded fraction does not establish an exact numerator. Preserve fungal stock Y1, all historical initial-curation notes, nitrogen versus growth-mediated valine interpretation, AI-2 activation/inhibition and the partial signaling bridge. Only the two GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events change. Full scientific review, source-snippet coverage and corpus QC remain separate.
